[Guidelines for Mode of Registration for Student of Backlog Courses | Section: GUIDELINES FOR MODE OF REGISTRATION FOR STUDENT OF BACKLOG COURSES | Clause: Clause (a) | Page: 1]
Category: Backlog & Registration Modes
Topic: Backlog Course Registration Modes: Exam Only Mode (EoM) vs Study Mode (SM)
Applicability: Students with backlog courses who met attendance requirements originally

Rule Content:
(a) Students who had met the attendance requirements in the semester when the course was originally registered may choose one of the following modes: I. Exam Only Mode (EOM): In this mode, students can appear directly for the Mid-Semester Examination (MSE) and End Semester Examination (ESE) without being required to attend classes again. Their previously earned Continuous Assessment (CA) marks will be carried forward. Further, provided the date of the exam doesn't clash with their current semester exam. II. Study Mode (SM): In this mode, students must register for the backlog course in the same semester in which it is offered to their junior batch as part of the regular curriculum, or during the summer semester if the course is available. Attendance is mandatory, and students must meet the required attendance criteria to be eligible for the examinations.

Conditions: Exam Only Mode is permissible ONLY if the student met attendance requirements during original course registration, and exam dates do not clash with current semester exams. Previously earned CA carried forward.
Exceptions: unknown

[Guidelines for Mode of Registration for Student of Backlog Courses | Section: GUIDELINES FOR MODE OF REGISTRATION FOR STUDENT OF BACKLOG COURSES | Clause: Clauses (b) & (c) | Page: 1]
Category: Backlog & Registration Modes
Topic: Mandatory Study Mode for Debarred, UFM, Attendance Detained & Year-Back Students
Applicability: Students with disciplinary action, UFM, attendance detention, or year-back status

Rule Content:
(b) UFM/Disciplinary action/Detention: Students who were debarred due to disciplinary action, involvement in unfair means (UFM), or shortage of attendance must re-register for the backlog courses in the semester when they are offered to their junior batch, or during the summer semester if available. These students are required to attend classes and satisfy the attendance requirements to qualify for the examinations. (c) Year-back Students: Students who got year back must re-register for the backlog courses in the semester when they are offered to their junior batch. These students are required to attend the classes and must meet the minimum attendance requirements in order to be eligible in the examinations.

Conditions: Students debarred for disciplinary, UFM, or attendance shortage, and year-back students, MUST take Study Mode with full class attendance. Exam Only Mode (EoM) is STRICTLY PROHIBITED for these students.
Exceptions: unknown

[Guidelines for Mode of Registration for Student of Backlog Courses | Section: GUIDELINES FOR MODE OF REGISTRATION FOR STUDENT OF BACKLOG COURSES | Clause: Clauses (a), (b), (c) | Page: 1]
Category: Backlog & Registration Modes
Topic: Procedure for Registering for Backlog Courses (EoM vs Study Mode)
Applicability: Students with backlog courses

Official Procedure:
1. Determine eligibility mode based on original attendance record:
   a. If student met attendance requirements originally: Choose Exam Only Mode (EoM) to appear in MSE/ESE directly without classes (previous CA marks carried forward, exam dates must not clash), OR choose Study Mode (SM) with regular junior batch or summer semester.
   b. If student was debarred for attendance shortage, UFM, disciplinary action, or year-back: MUST register under Study Mode (SM) with mandatory class attendance. Exam Only Mode is strictly disallowed.
2. Complete course registration online through Coordinator CUMS during designated registration windows.
3. Pay prescribed re-registration fees.
